Spanish 21 it is. You're playing blackjack with a 48-card deck that has no 10-spots (the J, Q and K stay in). Your 21 always wins, and your blackjack beats the dealer's blackjack. You get bonus payouts for a 21 made with five or more cards, and for 6-7-8 or 7-7-7. Double after split and late surrender are allowed. Everything else plays like regular blackjack.

You're starting with 1,000 chips. Set your bet on the table and deal when you're ready.
